description: Every permission the dashboard window has, and nothing else. The allow-* identifiers below the app command block are the application's own commands: they only exist because src-tauri/build.rs declares an app manifest, and without that manifest the same commands would be reachable from the webview with no grant at all. The plugin block is the one plugin namespace the frontend actually reaches: @tauri-apps/api/event listens for the gateway-state and deep-link events the dashboard subscribes to, and nothing else. Clipboard, notification, deep link and global shortcut are all driven from Rust, where the ACL does not apply, so granting them to the webview would only widen the surface; the window drag surface was dropped too, because no element in the dashboard carries a drag region. scripts/command_surface_test.py keeps the application grant list equal to the generate_handler! registration in src-tauri/src/lib.rs and fails when the two differ.
